mapper.select: /*common.coco.getApprovalMultiPathList*/ SELECT A.USER_ID, A.APP_PATH, A.SUBJECT, A.DEFAULT_FLAG, A.CHANGE_DATE, A.CHANGE_TIME, A.CHANGE_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS ADD_DATE, CASE WHEN NVL(A.CHANGE_DATE,' ') <> ' ' THEN A.CHANGE_DATE ELSE A.ADD_TIME END AS ADD_DATE_C, A.ADD_USER_ID, A.STATUS, NVL(SUBSTR(GETAPPUSERLIST('C',A.USER_ID,A.APP_PATH),0,LENGTH(GETAPPUSERLIST('C',A.USER_ID,A.APP_PATH))-1),'') AS TO_LIST, NVL(SUBSTR(GETAPPUSERLIST('R',A.USER_ID,A.APP_PATH),0,LENGTH(GETAPPUSERLIST('R',A.USER_ID,A.APP_PATH))-1),'') AS CC_LIST FROM ICOMAPPT A WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND NVL(A.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(APP_PATH)
mapper.update: /*common.coco.insertAppPathCreate*/ MERGE INTO ICOMAPPT A USING ( SELECT #{st_user_id} AS USER_ID, CASE WHEN NVL(#{app_path},' ') <> ' ' THEN #{app_path} ELSE TO_CHAR((SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(NVL(X.APP_PATH,'0'))),0) +1 FROM ICOMAPPT X WHERE X.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} )) END AS APP_PATH, #{subject} AS SUBJECT, NVL(#{defaultFlag},'N') AS DEFAULT_FLAG, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME, #{st_user_id} AS ADD_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME, #{st_user_id} AS CHANGE_USER_ID, 'C' AS STATUS FROM DUAL WHERE 1=1 ) B ON ( A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.APP_PATH = B.APP_PATH ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.DEFAULT_FLAG = B.DEFAULT_FLAG, A.SUBJECT = B.SUBJECT, A.CHANGE_USER_ID = B.CHANGE_USER_ID, A.CHANGE_DATE = B.CHANGE_DATE, A.CHANGE_TIME = B.CHANGE_TIME, A.STATUS = 'R' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( A.USER_ID, A.APP_PATH, A.SUBJECT, A.DEFAULT_FLAG, A.ADD_DATE, A.ADD_TIME, A.ADD_USER_ID, A.STATUS ) VALUES ( B.USER_ID, B.APP_PATH, B.SUBJECT, B.DEFAULT_FLAG, B.ADD_DATE, B.ADD_TIME, B.ADD_USER_ID, B.STATUS )
mapper.select:
/*common.coco.getApprovalMultiPathUserList*/ SELECT USER_NAME_LOC , USER_ID, DEPARTMENT, ( SELECT NVL(TEXT1,DEPARTMENT) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = COM_CODE AND TYPE='C001' AND CODE = DEPARTMENT ) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, POSITION, ( SELECT NVL(TEXT1,POSITION) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = COM_CODE AND TYPE='C003' AND CODE = POSITION ) AS POSITION_NAME FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE (STATUS ='C' OR STATUS='R') AND COM_CODE = (SELECT USR.COM_CODE FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AND (OFFICE_YN IS NULL OR OFFICE_YN <> 'Y' )
AND (USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || #{qstr} || '%' OR USER_NAME_ENG LIKE '%' || #{qstr} || '%')
AND USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{qstr} || '%'
AND DEPARTMENT IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = '' || #{qstr} || '' OR TEXT1 LIKE '%' || #{qstr} || '%' )
ORDER BY USER_NAME_LOC
mapper.update: /*common.coco.insertAppPathDetailCreate*/ INSERT INTO ICOMAPSE( APP_PATH, USER_ID, APPR_ID, APPR_NAME, APPR_SEQ, GUBUN, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, STATUS )VALUES( #{app_path}, #{st_user_id}, #{appr_id}, (SELECT X.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR X WHERE X.USER_ID = #{appr_id} AND ROWNUM = 1), #{appr_seq}, #{gubun}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #{st_user_id}, 'C' )
